faqs.question: What LED screen sizes are available?

faqs.question: What is pixel pitch and why does it matter?
faqs.answer: Pixel pitch is the distance between individual LED clusters. A smaller pitch produces a sharper image at close viewing distances, which is ideal for conferences and exhibitions. A larger pitch is appropriate for outdoor or large-venue screens where the audience is further away.

faqs.question: Can you integrate with our existing AV equipment?

faqs.question: What size TV should I hire?
faqs.answer: The best fit depends on your audience distance, the room and whether you are showing detailed slides or video. Send us your venue details so we can recommend an option and confirm availability.

faqs.question: Can I connect my own laptop?
faqs.answer: Tell us your laptop model and available display connections when enquiring. We will confirm the connection and any adapters needed before the event.

faqs.question: Can a TV be supplied with a stand?
faqs.answer: Include your preferred screen height and position in your enquiry. The mounting or stand arrangement will be confirmed with your quote.

faqs.question: Can I hire several TVs for an exhibition?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can enquire about multiple displays. Let us know the number of screens and whether each will show the same content or separate material.

shortIntro: Projector and projection screen hire for presentations, conferences and event video, with a setup tailored to your room.
fullIntro: Projection works best when the screen, projector position and room lighting are considered together. We help plan a display for your presentation content, audience and venue, including the space needed between the projector and screen. Share room dimensions, ceiling restrictions and any daylight or stage lighting that may affect the image. We can discuss projection alongside TV and LED options, then confirm the equipment, connections, installation and support in your quote.

faqs.question: Do I need to hire a screen with the projector?
faqs.answer: A suitable projection surface helps you plan a consistent image. Tell us if the venue already has a screen so we can discuss compatibility and what equipment is needed.

faqs.question: Can projection work in a bright room?
faqs.answer: Ambient light affects how a projected image looks. Share details of windows and room lighting; we can discuss light control or whether a TV or LED display would suit the venue better.

faqs.question: Can you provide sound for video playback?
faqs.answer: Yes. Include video playback and audience size in your brief so we can plan the audio equipment alongside the projection setup.

faqs.question: What does projector and screen hire cost?
faqs.answer: The quote depends on the display requirements, venue, duration and installation or support needed. Send your event details for an itemised proposal.

faqs.question: How many speakers will my event need?
faqs.answer: Coverage depends on the room shape, audience size, programme and speaker positions. Send a layout or describe the venue so we can plan a suitable setup.

faqs.question: Can I hire speakers with wireless microphones?
faqs.answer: Yes. Include the number of speakers or performers using microphones at the same time, plus any audience questions, in your enquiry.

faqs.question: Can you connect a laptop for music or video?
faqs.answer: Tell us which playback devices you want to use and what connections they have. We can confirm how to connect them to the event audio setup.

faqs.question: Can you support an outdoor event?
faqs.answer: Share the site layout, audience area, power arrangements and event schedule. We will discuss suitable equipment, positioning and weather planning before confirming the setup.

faqs.question: Can I hire microphones without speakers?
faqs.answer: Tell us about the sound system you intend to use. We can review the required connections and confirm a suitable microphone setup in your quote.

faqs.question: Which microphone format should I request?
faqs.answer: Describe whether speakers will hold a microphone, need their hands free or move around a stage. We will discuss a suitable format and confirm availability.

faqs.question: Can several wireless microphones be used together?
faqs.answer: Include the number needed at the same time and any other wireless audio at the venue. This lets us plan the system and setup requirements.

faqs.question: Do you provide someone to manage the microphones?
faqs.answer: Technical operation can be included where required. Let us know the running order, rehearsal times and any panel or audience handovers so support can be quoted.

Share your audience access requirements and whether remote contributors need to participate. Camera positions, audio feeds, rehearsals and technical operation are agreed before the event so the stream fits the wider production.

faqs.question: What internet connection does the venue need?
faqs.answer: A reliable connection must suit the planned stream. Share the venue connection details so the technical requirements and testing can be agreed before the event.

faqs.question: Can you include presentation slides in the stream?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tell us how presenters will supply slides and video so we can plan how these sources appear alongside the camera coverage.

faqs.question: Can remote speakers join the event?
faqs.answer: Tell us how many remote contributors are involved and which platform you plan to use. We can discuss the audio, display and rehearsal arrangements for a hybrid programme.

faqs.question: Can the event also be recorded?
faqs.answer: Include recording in the brief. We will confirm what can be captured, the deliverable format and any additional requirements in the quote.
